acceptanceCriteria: Codex skill routing matches the shipped CLI JS/TS impact profiles without claiming complete runtime or test coverage.
Applicable host skill copies and qualification/version rules remain consistent, with focused documentation checks.
body: Observed in VanillaTwisted consumer test bed on 2026-10-11. Clean source commit f0d0e6106d8f7ffeaac46339ba274df3aafc712f, Core 1.0.0-rc.3 build 456, Go 1.27.2 darwin/arm64. integrations/codex/plugins/corvint/skills/corvint/SKILL.md routes tracked .go paths and lists non-Go path impact as unsupported. Current impact help lists JavaScript/TypeScript path/range support. Reproduction: corvint --root /Users/russelllewis/projects/VanillaTwisted impact apps/web/src/core/comparison/comparison.ts --language-profile non-go-syntax-v0 --limit 10 exits 0 with READY syntax/import evidence and explicit omissions/unresolved-import/dynamic-dispatch uncertainty. Expected skill accurately routes supported bounded profiles, retaining limits; actual guidance discourages a working capability. Original receipt is /Users/russelllewis/projects/VanillaTwisted/.agent-evidence/corvint-testbed-20261011/comparison-impact.json. No source repair attempted.
title: Codex Corvint skill says non-Go path impact is unsupported despite JS/TS CLI support
